about_the_game:
Welcome to the demo of Road to Yvhalon!

This demo includes the initial parts of the adventure:

  • Forge the prophecy, choose your protagonist.

  • Learn the basic mechanics of real-time combat.

  • Discover the first parts of the vast world of Yvhalon.

  • Fight the first Aeons, mystical and demonic creatures.

Road To Yvhalon is an action RPG designed specifically for Virtual Reality, combining soulslike elements with innovative capture and exploration mechanics. Set in a vast, non-linear, and mysterious world, the game invites players to wander through forgotten lands, ancient ruins, and hidden paths, where the true adventure lies far from the main trails.Among the core gameplay elements are:

  • Sword crafting: Players can forge legendary blades by combining natural resources gathered from the environment with fragments obtained from defeated demons, creating unique and powerful weapons.

  • Enemy capture: Thanks to the SoulCapture system, it's possible to steal the souls of defeated enemies, such as arcane demons, to acquire their otherworldly powers, including flames, shadows, teleportation, and visions, which enrich your arsenal and abilities.

  • Boss combat: Battles take place in ritualistic and intense duels, using a sword pose system where the player's stance and intention influence the flow of the battle, making every encounter a "deadly dance" typical of the soulslike style.

  • Exploration of large VR maps: The world is vast and breathtaking, with open maps that encourage free exploration without explicit guides, challenging the player to discover secrets and alternative paths in an immersive environment optimized for VR.
